item.title: Khaitan acqui-hires 2018 Chennai start-up Assentio with Kannan, Cherian, Gopalakrishnan
item.description: Khaitan & Co has bolted on the Chennai-based law firm Assentio Legal, which had been started by Thriyambak Kannan, Rohan Cherian and Renu Gopalakrishnan, who will join from 1 July with their team in Khaitan’s Chennai and Bengaluru offices.

item.title: CAM entices Bharti Airtel group GC Sameer Chugh to private practice as Delhi TMT partner
item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas has hired Sameer Chugh as Delhi-based corporate and technology, media & telecommunication (TMT) and regulatory partner.

item.title: HSA hires ELP associate partner Ravi Jain into Mumbai projects & infra corporate
item.description: HSA Advocates has hired Ravi Jain from Economic Laws Practice (ELP) as a partner in its projects, energy & infrastructure practice.

item.title: Trilegal counsel Ipsita Chowdhury joins JSA partnership
item.description: Trilegal counsel Ipsita Chowdhury has joined J Sagar Associates (JSA) in Gurgaon as a salaried partner.

item.title: JurisCorp banking equity partner duo Nand Gopal Anand, Pratish Kumar join JSA
item.description: JurisCorp equity partners in its banking practice, Delhi-based Nand Gopal Anand and Mumbai-baseed Pratish Kumar, have joined J Sagar Associates (JSA) as partners in its Gurugram and Mumbai offices repsectively, according to a firm release.

item.title: Luthra co-founder Saraf & Partners opens doors today with warchest & corp hitters Jhawar, Kakkar + 18 (claimed & unnamed) others from L&L, 3 cities [UPDATE-2]
item.description: L&L Partners co-founder Mohit Saraf, who had won a minimum of Rs 77 crore settlement in a protracted arbitration and Delhi high court dispute and separation with fellow co-founder Rajiv Luthra, will announce the setting up of his own rival firm today, we understand according to multiple market sources.

item.title: Rajaram scores first recorded Softbank mandate with $1.25bn Swiggy shopping spree with SAM, Khaitan
item.description: Masayoshi Son-led SoftBank Vision Fund II has invested $450 million in food delivery platform Swiggy (Bundl Technologies Private Limited) leading the company’s massive $1.25 billion Series J round of fundraising, with India’s antitrust watchdog, the Competition Commission having greenlit the transaction a few days ago. It is expected that this investment will see Swiggy’s valuation soar to nearly $5.5 billion.

item.title: Squires India co-head Biswajit Chatterjee joins HogLove to grow Desi-Singapore practice
item.description: Hogan Lovells has poached Squire Patton Boggs India group co-chair and capital markets partner Biswajit Chatterjee into its corporate and finance practice in Singapore, according to the firm’s press release.

item.title: CLAT 2021: 62,106 out of 70,277 candidates appear: 61 questions objected to, 6 changes to answer key accepted
item.description: The CLAT consortium has accepted, after consultation with an expert committee and oversight committee, changes to the answer key of six questions, after receiving 1,026 individual objections over 61 questions in the exams.

item.title: Nalsar’s ‘21 batch first to reveal pandemic recruitments after long year: 100% jobs for 73 members
item.description: Nalsar Hyderabad’s recruitment coordination committee (RCC) has announced the the final results for recruitments for its 73 members in an exceedingly difficult and unusual year (full stats below).
